test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

At gurukul they spend many years together, growing into the best of friends, and ______ was time for each to return to his home, they wept.
solution:
The correct answer is "**when it."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"When it" is the most appropriate option to complete the sentence grammatically.**
 
• The sentence expresses the emotional bond between the friends and how they felt sad when they had to leave each other.
 
• The use of "they wept" emphasizes the depth of their friendship and the sorrow they felt at parting.
 
• **We use when as a conjunction meaning ‘at the time that’. **
 
• Thus, it is clear that the conjunction "when it" completes the given sentence grammatically as well as conceptually.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
